entries.subject: ESO eso0926a
entries.finding: The Eagle Nebula: B (451 nm), V (539 nm) and R (651 nm); 4000 × 4000 px over 32.08 × 32.08 arcmin. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.4811 arcsec per pixel, north 0.0° left of vertical, the frame's centre at 274.7059174°, -13.7638973°. Not measured against Gaia here.

entries.subject: A volume of the Eagle Nebula
entries.finding: The picture is flat. The Nebula Lab could spread its light in depth where a paper publishes the nebula's three-dimensional shape; that fit has not been made here.
entries.revisitWhen: A published three-dimensional model of the nebula is read and a Nebula Lab recipe is written from it.
